parameters.name: SSID
parameters.description: The SSID for fronthaul use across this Wi-Fi Multi-AP network.

parameters.name: Band
parameters.description: The band(s) (GHz) for which this {{param|SSID}} applies. {{enum}}

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enable or disable of this {{param|SSID}}. Disable stops the use of this {{param|SSID}}, but the object is retained. : {{true}}: this {{param|SSID}} is enabled. : {{false}}: this {{param|SSID}} is disabled.

parameters.name: AKMsAllowed
parameters.description: {{list}} List items indicate Authentication and Key Management (AKM) suites/security modes allowed on this BSS. {{enum}}

parameters.name: SuiteSelector
parameters.description: AKM suite selector, the AKM suite selector (OUI and type) is encoded as a 4-octet hex-encoded value without internal delimiters, e.g. 506F9A02 {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-151}}. This parameter applies if {{param|AKMsAllowed}} includes value "SuiteSelector".

parameters.name: AdvertisementEnabled
parameters.description: Indicates if the SSID is advertised in beacons, or not. : {{true}}: this {{param|SSID}} is to be advertised in beacons. : {{false}}: this {{param|SSID}} is not to be advertised in beacons.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Human-readable description for the BSS referenced by this {{object}}. For example {{param}} could be one of Primary, Home, Guest, Public, Private, Children, Video, Backhaul, Not Children, or Public 2.

object.description: This object specifies SSIDs for fronthaul use across all agents in this Wi-Fi Multi-AP network, or on this single-AP. Also specifies the {{param|Band}} for each {{param|SSID}}. The {{param|Alias}} can be used to uniquely refer to this table entry corresponding to a BSS even if the {{param|SSID}} were to change. Note that VLAN IDs (VIDs) can be configured per SSID with {{object|#.Device.{i}.SSIDtoVIDMapping.{i}}}.
